content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a game-changer for digital creators, particularly in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable. This system ensures that once a payment is confirmed through cryptocurrencies, the purchased ebook is delivered instantly to the buyer, eliminating delays and reliance on third-party services. This matters because it empowers creators to retain complete control over their sales process and customer data while minimizing transaction fees that can erode profits. For instance, while Gumroad takes 10% per sale, our solution through NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, allowing creators to keep more of their earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for automated ebook delivery leverages free tools and services to create a seamless experience for both sellers and buyers. It typically involves a combination of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting the store, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This architecture allows for real-time payment verification and automatic delivery of digital products. When a payment is made, the webhook from NOWPayments triggers the backend logic to deliver the ebook directly to the buyer's email or a secure download link. This system not only enhances efficiency but also reduces operational costs significantly.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries that face financial isolation or high transaction fees from established payment platforms. Creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products can greatly benefit from this setup. They can reach a global audience without the barriers imposed by traditional payment systems. Additionally, countries with unstable currencies or financial restrictions can leverage cryptocurrencies for stable transactions, making it easier to monetize their creations and retain full ownership of their data.
Control your sales process without relying on third-party platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture consists of several key components that ensure a functional and efficient sales process. First, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves as the storefront, providing a reliable hosting solution. Next, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic, facilitating interactions between the payment processor and the delivery mechanism. NOWPayments manages the crypto transactions and automates the payment verification process with minimal fees. Together, these elements create a cohesive system that allows creators to sell their products without relying on third-party platforms that may impose restrictions or take significant cuts from sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this system, start by selecting a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to create your storefront. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage payment interactions. Integrate NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrencies for your products, ensuring you configure the webhook for automatic delivery. Finally, load your digital products into the system and test the entire process to confirm that payments trigger the correct delivery actions. This setup is part of the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates for a successful deployment.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use a sovereign digital commerce stack that leverages cryptocurrency for payments. This setup allows for automated delivery of your ebook once payment is verified, eliminating the need for traditional payment platforms that may not be accessible. With tools like NOWPayments, you can significantly reduce transaction fees while retaining full ownership of your sales process.
Keep more of your profits with lower transaction fees using NOWPayments.

This kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates you need to establish a fully operational online store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about deploying your sovereign stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
